question: Application software includes a variety of programs that are designed to meet the information processing needs of _______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**end users**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **End users** are the primary beneficiaries of application software.
 
• Application software is designed to help **end users** perform specific tasks such as word processing, web browsing, and managing data.
 
• Other roles like **programmers** and **team leaders** may use application software, but the software is generally created with the needs of the **end users** in mind.
 
• Examples of application software include **Microsoft Office, Adobe Photoshop, and Google Chrome**, which are used by **end users** for various personal and professional activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **System software** differs from application software in that it is designed to manage system resources and provide a platform for application software to run.
 
• **Examples of system software** include operating systems like **Windows, macOS, and Linux**.
 
• Application software is generally more user-friendly and accessible to non-technical users compared to system software.
 
• With the rise of cloud computing, many application software solutions are now available as **Software as a Service (SaaS)**, which allows **end users** to access software applications over the internet.
